headline: Nvidia Groq 3 LPX delivers ultrafast inference for long-context clinical applications
body: Nvidia announced the Groq 3 LPX processor, designed to handle long-context processing with substantially reduced latency compared to prior generations. For healthcare AI, this matters because clinical decision support systems and documentation analysis require processing extensive patient records, lab histories, and imaging reports without speed degradation. Long-context capability at fast inference speeds directly improves real-time EHR integration and reduces clinician wait times in workflows where AI assists diagnosis or treatment planning. Meanwhile, Nvidia customers are absorbing 15% price increases on AI infrastructure, creating cost pressure that makes efficiency gains from Groq 3 architecturally significant for health systems evaluating deployment costs.
